title: Reconcile T7 navigation with existing TechDev category calibration
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic navigation/runtime reconciliation so the existing T7 TechDev owner exposes the later canonical category calibration and machine-readable anchor outcomes without rewriting historical source ledgers, claiming exhaustive full-corpus scoring or changing TechDev authority.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/research/directly related TechDev calibration reconciliation helper if existing routing requires code

evidence.summary: Older T7 navigation reports 186 source-backed rows and zero scored outcomes.
Later canonical calibration reports 257 source-backed claims, 50 anchor rows evaluated, 44 outcome-eligible anchors and category-specific learning with machine-readable owners.

reproduction: On fresh main, compare the T7 operational ledger/current registry state to the later canonical TechDev category calibration and confirm navigation can still expose the older zero-outcome state without reconciling the newer anchor-cohort calibration.

positive: Current T7 readout links the 257-row corpus and the separate 50-anchor/44-outcome-eligible calibration cohort with exact machine-readable owner paths and category verdicts.
First-call and revision information/cost remain separate and blocked/non-evaluable categories remain explicit.
negative: The implementation never claims 44 anchors equal exhaustive scoring of all 257 claims.
No old source ledger is deleted or rewritten and no TechDev market weight, execution authority or portfolio action changes.
